Features 29 integrated tools, 9 LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Mistral, etc.), 9 communication channels (Telegram, Slack, Discord, email, webhooks), 2,900+ tests, and multi-tenant architecture. Supports Docker, Landlock, Firejail, and Bubblewrap sandboxing. Prometheus metrics on /metrics. Non-root container.
templates.name: zeptoclaw
